scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

intervention.sampling_law: Bernoulli(1-q) clear of tape and registers
intervention.normalisation: loss vs the dose's own baseline
intervention.alters_baseline_function: checked per dose: eligible only inside the band of q=1 and above the floor
intervention.qualification: q=1 must reproduce evaluate() exactly (harness check)

damage_ruler.normalisation: loss = D2/D3 share over draws (binary); dreward = absolute reward_per_ask change
damage_ruler.denominator: draws (4) per cell; programs paired with themselves
damage_ruler.alters_baseline_function: no: the baseline is the undamaged program; the sham path verifies the route

readings.STATE_CAUSAL: among programs with >= 2 eligible doses, paired loss(lowest eligible q) - loss(q=1) outside its sign-flip band
readings.STATE_ENTANGLED_WITH_FUNCTION: fewer than 8 programs keep function at any q < 1
readings.STATE_CORRELATED: persistent words correlate with loss at q=1 (Spearman clears band) but the dose contrast is inside its band
readings.NO_RESIDUAL_STATE_EFFECT: dose contrast inside band and no correlation

material_rule: reading is STATE_CAUSAL, or the harness check fails (recorded), or STATE_ENTANGLED is itself the finding
